label: H.R. 7412

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 425.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: H.R. 7412 amends the Small Business Act to establish an Office of Whistleblower Awards within the Small Business Administration. The office will collect original information from whistleblowers regarding financial misconduct or fraudulent misrepresentation related to COVID financial assistance, track its use in legal actions, and pay financial rewards to eligible whistleblowers out of a newly created Treasury fund. It also imposes civil monetary penalties on individuals convicted of or settling COVID loan actions and includes anti-retaliation protections.

affected_groups.effect: Individuals who provide original information on COVID loan fraud may receive financial awards, status updates, and anti-retaliation protections, provided they were not involved in planning or initiating the misconduct.

Entities or individuals who received financial assistance from the Small Business Administration face potential civil penalties of 30 percent of the loan principal if convicted of or settling a COVID loan action.
The agency must establish the Office of Whistleblower Awards, issue required rules, submit annual reports to Congress, and manage fund deposits and disbursements.

key_provisions: Establishes an Office of Whistleblower Awards within the Small Business Administration to process and track original information about COVID loan fraud or misconduct.
Provides financial awards to whistleblowers whose original information leads to a final conviction, settlement, or plea agreement in a COVID loan action.
Sets award amounts at 10 percent of collected funds for U.S. nationals or entities, and 15 percent for foreign nationals or entities.
Creates a revolving fund in the Department of the Treasury called the Whistleblower Award Fund to pay out awards and administrative expenses.
Imposes an additional civil monetary penalty equal to 30 percent of the aggregate principal amount of loans on persons finally convicted or settling a COVID loan action.
Prohibits retaliation against individuals who make or assist with whistleblower disclosures under this section and allows them to seek legal relief.
Sets a sunset date for the authority linked to the conclusion of all timely filed COVID loan actions and related appeals.
missing_information: The total expected number of whistleblowers or fraudulent loans that will be identified.
The exact administrative operating expenses required to run the Office of Whistleblower Awards.
Any estimated net revenue or cost to the federal government resulting from the 30 percent civil monetary penalties and whistleblower payouts.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 7412 amends the Small Business Act to establish an Office of Whistleblower Awards within the Small Business Administration. The office will collect original information from whistleblowers regarding financial misconduct or fraudulent misrepresentation related to COVID financial assistance, track its use in legal actions, and pay financial rewards to eligible whistleblowers out of a newly created Treasury fund. It also imposes civil monetary penalties on individuals convicted of or settling COVID loan actions and includes anti-retaliation protections.
summary_detail.significance: The bill creates a formal financial incentive structure and dedicated office within the Small Business Administration specifically for reporting fraud related to COVID-19 relief loans. It changes how the federal government collects penalties and distributes rewards for whistleblower tips regarding pandemic-era small business financial assistance.
